findings.summary: The GLOB pattern for starts_with and ends_with does not escape '[', so a literal bracket starts a character class and matches the wrong rows.
select wraps its query in 'with conn:', which commits whatever the caller had pending on the connection.
Swapping the sides of an ordering negates it instead of mirroring it, so `5` < n compiles to n >= 5.
The double-quote check only looks at a plain field, so a key with a double quote inside a dotted path goes into the JSON path unescaped and reads another field (team."a\".\"b" reads team.a.b).
